title: The stranded and queued query-log findings are closed with their reasons, and the queue's tool defect becomes a backlog bug
goal: After ST-nknh77bp, ST-34m3yiyn and ST-uy4d752n land, each finding of the sprint goal leaves no-fix or the queue in the committed store kb/_querylog, through querylog.py close (or learn's fixed-since on HEAD): the off-target ones (F-071ee8797647 asks what logs the kb tooling keeps, F-6f7e881cdca1 which planned sprint starts next, F-740275aab993 a pasted research-goal prompt) are rejected as off the kb's domains; F-384650090243 (a bl_land.ops_no_work_rows defect pasted as a question) has its kb/public/_gaps.md entry removed, is rejected, and is filed as a backlog bug if no item covers it; the misses answered by eval rows (F-32e0e03abedf, F-b28d0d79b19b, F-fe10582bc61f), the rules misses (F-80eef23e135d, F-cd5fa1250653) and the researched gaps (F-ae2f85ba904e, F-6ac5244b1e3d, F-98c7f667e2cd) are recorded fixed-since, claimed or closed --tried with what they still need; then querylog.py show --findings --state no-fix lists none of them and querylog.py queue lists no gap. How a no-fix eval finding whose expected article was wrong is closed (reject, tried, or a re-run of learn) is left to the work.

run: import subprocess,sys;ids=['F-071ee8797647','F-6f7e881cdca1','F-740275aab993','F-32e0e03abedf','F-b28d0d79b19b','F-fe10582bc61f','F-80eef23e135d','F-cd5fa1250653','F-6ac5244b1e3d'];r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/querylog.py','show','--findings','--state','no-fix','--limit','0'],capture_output=True,text=True);left=[i for i in ids if i in r.stdout];print('still no-fix:',left or 'none');sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and not left else 1)

import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/querylog.py','queue','20'],capture_output=True,text=True);ok=r.returncode==0 and 'queued=0' in r.stdout;print(r.stdout.splitlines()[0] if r.stdout else r.stderr);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
